system_boundary: Locked SmolVLA evaluator and outer episode ledger; training and oracle evidence remain separate.

operational_definitions.observation: normalized agent/wrist images, state tensor and task string consumed by policy.select_action
operational_definitions.action: CPU NumPy action vector passed once to env.step
operational_definitions.success: is_success_done at done and safety cost not above the configured limit
operational_definitions.failure: non-success terminal, timeout or recorded exception

stopping_rule: stop at registered matrix even when estimates are inconclusive
analysis_plan: Wilson intervals and exact paired test with fail-closed missing pairs
resource_plan: Account for all attempted runs including failures; keep not-run only in planned denominator.
boundary: Synthetic protocol exercise only; it does not document an executed VLA-Arena study.
